questions.q: The consultant ______ we hired last month has already suggested several changes.
questions.exp: 先行詞 consultant 是人，空格後面是 we hired，缺受詞；受詞位置用 who（也可以用 whom、that）。which 不用在人；whose 後面要接先行詞「的」名詞；what 前面不能有先行詞。

questions.q: The new copier, ______ was installed on Monday, has already broken down.
questions.exp: 有逗號的非限定子句，先行詞是東西、缺主詞，用 which。that 不能用在非限定子句；what 前面不能有先行詞；who 指人。

questions.q: We need to find a supplier ______ products meet our safety standards.
questions.exp: 空格後面接名詞 products，是「供應商的產品」，用 whose。

questions.q: This is the office ______ I worked when I first joined the company.
questions.exp: I worked 是完整的子句（work 在這裡不接受詞），指地點用 where（＝in which）。which、that 要在句尾補 in 才對。

questions.q: Mr. Okada is the person to ______ you should send your application.
questions.exp: 介系詞 to 直接放在前面、指人，用 whom。介系詞後面不直接接 who 或 that；which 不用在人。

questions.q: ______ surprised us most was the low cost of the project.
questions.exp: 前面沒有先行詞，「最讓我們驚訝的事」＝the thing that surprised us most，用 What。

questions.q: The engineers who ______ the new bridge will present their plan tomorrow.
questions.exp: who 指 engineers（複數）；designs、has designed 是單數的形式，designing 不是有時態的動詞，只有 designed 對。

questions.q: Sales rose by 20 percent last year, ______ pleased the shareholders.
questions.exp: 讓股東高興的是「業績成長兩成」這整件事，指前面整句話用 which。it 會變成兩個完整句子只用逗號接起來。

questions.q: 哪一句的關係代名詞可以省略？
opts: The training course that we attended was very useful.
The trainer who led the course was very experienced.
The course, which lasted three days, was very useful.
The room that was used for the course was too small.
questions.exp: The training course that we attended… 的 that 是 attended 的受詞（後面接主詞 we），可以省。led、was used 前面的 who、that 是主詞，不能省；有逗號的非限定子句也不能省。

questions.q: The day ______ the new office opens has not been decided yet.
questions.exp: 先行詞 day 是時間，後面 the new office opens 是完整的子句，用 when。指時間不用 where。
